row.title: The specification tools run without the private specification (DISCLOSE-1)
row.body: The conformance CLI --write overwrote the committed manifest with an empty one when given an empty specification directory. It now refuses, spec_truth, req_ids and spec_backlog report unmeasured on no text, and disclosure --tooling runs each against an empty directory and fails on a crash, a false pass or a rewritten manifest.

title: The specification tools run without the private specification (DISCLOSE-1)
